content.rendered:
A family-like environment – I have been working for Harlow International for over two years as a front desk officer, during my experience in the company I have worked with my colleagues on the basis of unity, teamwork, and respect. This environment has contributed positively towards my own personal development as I have been able to communicate with all of my colleagues clearly which helps in broadening my knowledge and widening my skill set.

Encouraging me to learn and develop every day, Harlow international has taught me that a front desk officer should be a people person. Therefore, I enjoy engaging with the public and being service-oriented to provide hotel guests with an exceptional experience every single day.

Throughout my journey, I have had access to excellent mentors, and great training programs, which Harlow’s provides as part of the people’s focus on the organization.

Working in a large organization such as Harlow International means that learning and personal development will continue throughout your entire journey.

Mohammed Firas
Front Desk Officer
Baghdad, Iraq

Companies all over the world usually seek to hire employees with “ready-made” experiences, however, only a few organizations believe in nurturing employees to achieve their potential. I was one of the lucky ones that have started a career in a company that adopted me entirely.

My journey started with Harlow International as a junior equipment operator where I learned the basics of standardization and construction-related processes.

After a couple of years of fully embracing that experience, my need for more growth was growing. I went directly to my line manager where I have been warmly welcomed and I have been offered many training hours from the best in the construction and engineering fields to enhance my capabilities and to be ready for my new role.

Years passed, and Harlow became my second family, a family where hard work pays off in the right environment, and this is where I was, am and where will I be.

Abdullah Tariq
Site Foreman
Baghdad, Iraq

title.rendered: Kiyoung Ko – Business Development Manager & Chemical Engineer

content.rendered:
In my position, each day presents a new challenge and learning opportunity. All the challenges become opportunities as I work with a bunch of talented people with an amazing passion for work and an energy that is infectious. Harlow Group is a great place to work and strives for a friendly, team-oriented environment, are sensitive to balancing work and personal time, and are always ready to provide assistance or education to help you learn new skills. Most of our Leaders know you by name, no one at Harlow Group ever had the feeling of being “just a number” like in other organizations. I feel the camaraderie in the office between all levels of employees, which creates an energetic work environment where one can easily create and share new ideas. This provides a wonderful family and community feel. Our successes, milestones, and achievements are always recognized. It is gratifying when you are able to help your employees step up in life by providing learning & development opportunities and nurturing them to be the best they can be. Opportunities are limitless. if you are ambitious. Coming to work every day has been easy and enjoyable because it’s not like coming to work it’s like coming to see your extended family. I am really excited to see what the future holds for me within Harlow International Group.
Kiyoung Ko
Business Development Manager & Chemical Engineer
Republic of Korea

I started my career with Harlow Group as a site civil engineer in 2019. Since then, I have been involved in many project-related operations spanning multiple regions across Iraq. Within two years, I oversaw completing very important projects such as the new headquarter for the company. Harlow ensures you are provided with the right tools and path for career growth.

Working for Harlow Group means that I am surrounded by great and passionate leaders who work together like a team which made me genuinely feel the alignment between my values and the company’s values.

Harlow is a goal-driven company that is constantly evolving. We work in a family culture where everyone is treated equally, and cultural diversity is respected. Working in a large organization such as Harlow means opportunities present themselves that you might not have considered – I would encourage you to go for them!

Baraa Mohammed
Civil Engineer
Baghdad, Iraq
